tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: undyed linen in light, dark wool in dark. Every page sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The one raised surface: the Now block, code blocks, an open footnote. Never for every card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and the mark's inner ring. 13.8:1 on paper (light), 14.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, reading time, captions, glosses. 4.8:1 on paper (light), 6.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: The only accent: the mark's outer ring, links, the post ornament, the initial letter, focus ring. A few percent of any screen. 4.6:1 on paper (light), 6.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-rust
tokens.usage: Text or the mark placed on a rust field (Telegram avatar, rare buttons). 4.6:1 (light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and around the Now block. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on Home only. 36px below 640px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and post titles. 28px below 640px.

styles.name: item
styles.sample: ADRs are letters to the next team

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, nav, captions. Always muted or ink, never rust.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed. Sentence case, no tracking.

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: Маё імя мае два напісанні, і абодва правільныя.
styles.usage: Long-read body text, max 34em wide (about 70 characters).

styles.name: read-dek
styles.sample: Every Belarusian name has two spellings. A URL can only hold one.
styles.usage: The one-sentence dek under a post title. The only italic in the system.

styles.name: read-note
styles.sample: Łacinka has more than one convention.
styles.usage: Footnotes, open inline or listed at the end.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks on paper-raised, scrolling sideways inside their own box.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Gaps inside a group are smaller than gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Mark to wordmark; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside list rows, ornament to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; padding of the Now block on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter between columns; Now block padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page edge; between paragraphs of sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Header to page title on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Mark tiles when drawn in CSS; tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inputs, the language switch focus box.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Now block and post cover images. Nothing else is rounded more.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest content box on any page.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Long-read text column, about 70 characters at 20px.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Interface prose such as About and Now.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of every link row and control.
